test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'LIBERTY' is coded as ‘NKDETVA’ and 'TONIGHT' is coded as ‘VQPIIJV’. How will 'AUCTION' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e975eec7941f96b2014ca014cc7041899af15adb33154ee8a8af306f9ba4b7e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'LIBERTY' is coded as ‘NKDETVA’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99af464081d1a93bd6cc82a9cc402d26ca3d98a1ad60233ec589fd9ec2700b0b.png] 

'TONIGHT' is coded as ‘VQPIIJV’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1644b23a1e4064628745d46197de18cec165c98853a553a3fe3afcd96b60a50.png] 

Similarly, '**AUCTION**' will be coded:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef775b98b17b2fd96b860e78944d646c6d6129915c024acecba6e49b54298c3d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "CWETKQP".**
